historical_authority.transport_note: R26 uses compact deterministic execution transport. Exact semantic wording remains owned by the cited legacy comment plus latest Chat judgment; owner ordinals are coverage metadata and named learner surfaces drive Expansion acceptance.

bulk_readback.transport_note: The final R26 run uses compound-aware owner mapping so hyphenated learner surfaces such as `high-caliber` resolve to the appropriate Current component owner (`caliber`) without changing the approved surface text.

review_model: dual-track: migration fidelity + latest semantic target under current LEARNING_CONTRACT; historical authority is evidence, not immutable truth

core.rule: all other historical R26 Core targets are defective or still require semantic reclassification/organization at current evidence

severe_examples.word:tuberculosis: Current only says the disease is caused by bacteria and most often affects the lungs; it does not preserve the precise Mycobacterium tuberculosis cause or the pulmonary-vs-all-TB boundary.
severe_examples.word:villa: Current foregrounds a generic detached-or-sem​​idetached suburban house and an ancient-Roman branch instead of the modern large detached/country/holiday residence model.
severe_examples.word:aborigines: Current owner has Active=0 and lacks the required sensitive case-aware Australian Aboriginal peoples treatment.
severe_examples.word:ambivalent: Current reduces ambivalence to uncertainty/indecision and misses mixed or opposing feelings.
severe_examples.word:annihilate: Current says kill in large numbers rather than destroy completely.
severe_examples.word:apex: Current foregrounds a specialist astronomical apex and misses ordinary top/highest/most-successful-point Core.
severe_examples.word:balmy: Current owner has Active=0 and its Core is contaminated by the `barmy` mental-irregularity sense.
severe_examples.word:buff: Current foregrounds polish/leather/naked senses and omits the high-frequency enthusiast/expert branch (`film buff`).
severe_examples.word:caption: Current owner has Active=0 and its Core is contaminated by `captious`-like quibbling rather than explanatory text/subtitle.
severe_examples.word:categorical: Current retains only category-related meaning and misses common absolute/unqualified/explicit usage.
severe_examples.word:caustic: Current retains only corrosive chemistry and misses common biting/sarcastic remarks.
severe_examples.word:censure: Current has criticism noun only and lacks the ordinary verb.

direct_pass_calibration.rule: small stratified calibration of historical Core-direct-pass owners; isolated low-value cleanup in a sample does not constitute a new systematic Core defect and does not create learner-state mutation

fresh_semantic_judgments.latest: Current already preserves the three useful branches: land tract, anatomical tract/system, and pamphlet/treatise.
State that TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis; pulmonary TB is common but not synonymous with all tuberculosis.
Preserve proper-name/capitalization identity and the planet vs Roman-goddess branches without collapsing them into an undifferentiated lowercase owner presentation.
Common learner Core is repugnant/offensive; the formal contrary/incompatible-with branch may remain below normal Active rather than forcing another Main sense.
Use sensitive case-aware treatment for Australian Aboriginal peoples; generic lowercase `aborigines` is dated and Indigenous peoples is often preferable.
Core is having mixed or opposing feelings, not merely uncertainty or inability to decide.
Current willingness/responsiveness/susceptibility branches already form a sound learner model; keep `amenable to` as Expansion structure rather than another Core sense.
Restore noun added building/section plus verb attach/take territory and encode the noun/verb stress boundary explicitly.
Current weaponry/military-equipment Core is sufficient for ordinary learner use; military-buildup wording can remain contextual rather than a forced competing Main sense.
Center protection/refuge/right to protection; psychiatric-institution use is historical/dated and needs explicit register control.
Core is pleasantly warm/mild/soothing; remove the `barmy` mental-irregularity contamination.
Restore the high-frequency enthusiast/expert branch (`film buff`) alongside polish/muscular/tan uses; leather/naked material must not lead learner Core.
Preserve waterfall and eye-lens clouding as real polysemy, with the medical branch not buried behind the waterfall sense for this learner context.
Add/promote absolute, unqualified or explicit meaning while retaining category-related usage.
Keep corrosive chemistry and add the common biting/sarcastic-language branch.
Current repetitive-song plus musical-recitation/psalm model is broad enough to cover protest and religious chant without further Core fragmentation.
